facts.text: Late in the season there is no dependable water above the old mine, so carry the day's supply from there.
In early October the snow gully and apron were bare, leaving dry rock the whole way.
Splitting the chimney into two pitches under 30 m each keeps partners within calling range.
Camping in the basin below the notch, or at High Pass, shortens summit day.
In early October the last forested stretch to the trailhead is steep and was reached in darkness; keep a headlamp handy.
In early September one party wandered off line and lost an hour; follow a downloaded track.

notes: Our NE Face row has no trailhead pin and no track climbs it; the glacier line shows no recordings.
